mapper.select: SELECT SCHEDULE_NO , USER_ID , SCHEDULE_NAME , SCHEDULE_CONTENT FROM SCHEDULE WHERE SCHEDULE_NO = #{scheduleNo}
SELECT SCHEDULE_NO , USER_ID , SCHEDULE_NAME , SCHEDULE_CONTENT FROM SCHEDULE

WITH base_applicants AS ( SELECT applicant_id FROM applicant WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) SELECT ar.applicant_id, rp.recruitment_no, rn.recruitment_title, rn.user_id, rp.recruit_process_step AS step, rp.recruit_process_type AS step_type, ar.STEP_PASS_YN AS pass, rp.recruit_process_final AS final, re.recruit_exam_name, TO_CHAR(re.recruit_exam_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS exam_datetime, i.interview_location, i.interview_type, CASE WHEN i.interview_type = 'Y' THEN TO_CHAR(ar.evaluation_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') ELSE TO_CHAR(i.interview_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') END AS interview_datetime FROM applicant_record ar JOIN recruit_process rp ON ar.recruit_process_no = rp.recruit_process_no JOIN recruitment_notice rn ON rp.recruitment_no = rn.recruitment_no LEFT JOIN recruitment_exam re ON rp.recruit_process_no = re.process_no LEFT JOIN interview i ON rp.recruit_process_no = i.process_no WHERE ar.applicant_id IN (SELECT applicant_id FROM base_applicants) AND rn.recruitment_del_date is null

SELECT c.RECRUITMENT_NO , c.USER_ID , c.RECRUITMENT_TITLE , c.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE , c.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE FROM scrab_company sc JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE c ON sc.company_id = c.user_id WHERE sc.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT c.RECRUITMENT_NO , c.USER_ID , c.RECRUITMENT_TITLE , c.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE , c.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE FROM scrab_recruitment sr JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE c ON sr.RECRUITMENT_NO = c.RECRUITMENT_NO WHERE sr.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT SCHEDULE_NO , USER_ID , SCHEDULE_NAME , SCHEDULE_CONTENT , TO_CHAR(SCHEDULE_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as scheduleStartDate , TO_CHAR(SCHEDULE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as scheduleEndDate FROM SCHEDULE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT -- RECRUITMENT_NOTICE rn.RECRUITMENT_NO AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_NO, rn.USER_ID AS RENO_USER_ID, rn.RECRUITMENT_TITLE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_TITLE, rn.JOB_CODE AS RENO_JOB_CODE, rn.YEAR_CODE AS RENO_YEAR_CODE, rn.REC_CONTENT AS RENO_REC_CONTENT, rn.PREFERENTIAL AS RENO_PREFERENTIAL, rn.CITY_CODE AS RENO_CITY_CODE, rn.DISTRICT_CODE AS RENO_DISTRICT_CODE, rn.REC_POSITION_NUMBER AS RENO_REC_POSITION_NUMBER, rn.RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL, rn.RECRUITMENT_SALARY AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_SALARY, rn.WELFARE AS RENO_WELFARE, rn.RECRUITMENT_DESK AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_DESK, rn.RECRUITMENT_IMG AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_IMG, rn.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE, rn.RECRUITMENT_RECEIPT_START AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_RECEIPT_START, rn.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE, rn.RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE, rn.RECRUIT_FINISH_YN AS RENO_RECRUIT_FINISH_YN,
-- RECRUIT_PROCESS (1:N) rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO, rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP, rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_FINAL AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_FINAL, rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE, rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_DEL_DATE AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_DEL_DATE,
-- RECRUITMENT_EXAM (1:N) re.RECRUIT_EXAM_NO AS REEX_RECRUIT_EXAM_NO, re.RECRUIT_EXAM_NAME AS REEX_RECRUIT_EXAM_NAME, re.RECRUIT_EXAM_CUTLINE AS REEX_RECRUIT_EXAM_CUTLINE, TO_CHAR(re.recruit_exam_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS REEX_RECRUIT_EXAM_START_DATE,
i.INTERVIEW_NO AS ITVI_INTEVIEW_NO, TO_CHAR(i.interview_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ITVI_INTEIVEW_DATE, i.INTERVIEW_LOCATION AS ITVI_INTERVIEW_LOCATION, i.INTERVIEW_TYPE AS ITVI_INTERVIEW_TYPE, i.INTERVIEW_PASS_SCORE AS ITVI_INTERVIEW_PASS_SCORE
FROM RECRUITMENT_NOTICE rn LEFT JOIN RECRUIT_PROCESS rp ON rn.RECRUITMENT_NO = rp.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT_EXAM re ON rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = re.PROCESS_NO LEFT JOIN INTERVIEW i ON rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = i.PROCESS_NO WHERE rn.USER_ID = #{userId} AND rn.RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE IS NULL
